title: Herding and Liquidity in Order-Book Markets. III. Leverage and the Onset of Endogenous Liquidity Crises under Weak Anchoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.20192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fundamental-value anchoring of resting liquidity is a causal stabiliser of an order-book market: while the anchor holds, even a heavily leveraged book stays quiet. We take that anchor strength as a continuous control and characterise the endogenous liquidity crises that appear once it is nearly removed. In a single continuous-double-auction market driven by anchored noise traders, chartist herders, a population of funding-constrained market makers, and leveraged holders subject to margin calls, no exogenous shock is injected, so that any crisis is self-generated. Weakening the anchor turns on both classical leverage stylised facts: the return tail exponent falls from about 6.5 to 2.3 and the integrated volatility autocorrelation roughly doubles, although the clustering is short-memory rather than the long-memory of real markets. Isolating the crisis as a matched-herding levered-minus-unlevered book-depletion increment, we find it confine

translated_title: 订单簿市场中的羊群行为与流动性（III）：弱锚定下杠杆与内生流动性危机的爆发
translated_abstract: 挂单流动性的基本面价值锚定是订单簿市场的因果性稳定器：只要锚定仍然有效，即使订单簿带有高杠杆也能保持平静。我们将锚定强度作为一个连续控制变量，刻画了当锚定几乎被完全移除时出现的内生流动性危机。在一个由锚定噪声交易者、图表派羊群交易者、一群受资金约束的做市商以及面临保证金追缴的杠杆持有者共同驱动的单一连续双向拍卖市场中，不注入任何外生冲击，因此任何危机都是自我生成的。削弱锚定会激活两种经典的杠杆化市场典型事实：收益尾指数从约6.5降至2.3，积分波动率自相关性大约翻倍，尽管这种波动聚集呈现短记忆特性而非真实市场的长记忆特性。通过将危机隔离为匹配羊群条件下杠杆化与非杠杆化订单簿耗竭增量之差，我们发现其被限制在……
tldr: 本文将订单簿市场中挂单流动性的基本面锚定强度作为连续控制变量，发现在无任何外生冲击的情况下，锚定的近乎消失会使杠杆与羊群行为相互作用，从而自我生成内生流动性危机，并触发收益厚尾与波动率聚集等经典杠杆化市场典型事实。
en_tdlr: This paper treats fundamental-value anchor strength as a continuous control in an order-book market and shows that, with no exogenous shocks, nearly removing the anchor lets leverage and herding self-generate endogenous liquidity crises, reproducing classical leveraged-market stylised facts such as heavy return tails and volatility clustering.
